strategy_doc_section_loaded: M1 in detail — getting going + context (incl. Recurring themes list, No plan mode in M1, No Skill use at M1, practitioner-arc pre-reads) cross-checked against the M1 table row and M2 in detail for the forward-sequencing boundary

rules_evaluated.evidence: Big Idea (lines 5-6) frames the first-session artefact as what makes the next session compound; maintainer Meta block (line 106) names the mood explicitly as joyful creation — 'it works, on my repo' — and matches the strategy doc's M1 mood exactly. 'How we work in this room' / 'Freedom to choose' (lines 22-34) are setup beats (mood-exempt), not teaching beats, so they don't dilute the arc. Nothing in the body resolves or forecloses the mood early; it stays open through 'Next' (lines 65-66).

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Epistemic mood is not punitive mood
rules_evaluated.evidence: M1's contracted mood is joyful creation, not unease, so the epistemic-vs-punitive test doesn't apply. Checked for accidental shame anyway: 'All learners... everyone struggles to keep up' (line 24) normalizes difficulty collectively rather than individually, and 'The agent's self-report is a hypothesis, not ground truth' (line 59) frames the introspection discipline as a fact about the tool, not a student failing.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Lead with discipline, not failure mode
rules_evaluated.evidence: Big Idea leads with 'leave something behind' (line 6), not a failure word. What You'll Learn (lines 16-20) leads every bullet with a positive-discipline verb: Run, Distinguish, Fix, Close, Compound. Key Concepts (lines 57-63) lead with the loop, context, the agent's self-report, a failing test, the rules file, and tracker conventions — none open on a failure noun. 'no plan mode' (line 18) is a scope qualifier inside a discipline bullet, not a title.

The file keeps M1's four-exercise order (orient → fix → close → compound, matching strategy doc's 'compound sits last... close sits third') and explicitly withholds plan mode ('no plan mode' line 18), which the strategy doc records as a deliberate, previously-litigated restraint ('No plan mode in M1... Recorded 2026-08-02 so an audit does not re-flag the word'). No Skill or subagent use appears, matching 'No Skill use at M1.' The 'Next' section (lines 65-66) and the Module 2 pre-reads (lines 68-78) name M2's destination ('plan mode earns its keep,' 'a second pass that pressure-tests the plan') only at the level of forward-arc signposting — it never names the walk-down-branches / grill-me mechanic the strategy doc reserves for M2's own reveal, so it doesn't front-run M2's teaching moment.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Strategic themes recur in Key Concepts
rules_evaluated.evidence: Key Concepts (lines 57-63) instance at least four of the strategy doc's stated M1 themes ('mirror; self-aware + grain of salt; 90% correct; capture-your-world; compounding'): compounding (loop bullet + CLAUDE.local.md bullet), self-aware/grain-of-salt + mirror (the self-report-as-hypothesis bullet), 90%-correct (the /context unread-slice bullet), and capture-your-world (the tracker-conventions bullet). Clears the 2-3-instance floor.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Key Concepts shape — theme breadcrumbs, not standalone section
rules_evaluated.evidence: All six Key Concepts bullets (lines 57-63) recap moves the four exercises already ran (emergent, not lectured-before-doing), pass §3/§4/§5 first, and none carries a bold 'Remember:' label or standalone themes section. Several bullets close on a compact clause that reads as the theme's essence without a marker (e.g. 'Context is what you put in it'; 'The scrollback is the machine's reflection; current state lives on disk'; 'One ticket is enough to start reading them back') — no bullet fails the discipline/sequencing/theme gates, so nothing needed cutting before the shape check.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: What You'll Learn shape — capability register, not syllabus
rules_evaluated.evidence: Lines 16-20 are five engineer-readable capability bullets — Run, Distinguish, Fix, Close, Compound — each with a concrete object (the loop, the agent's account vs. the repo, the bug + PR, the ticket, the rules file at ./CLAUDE.local.md). No Bloom-tag parentheticals, no '-by X' mechanism tails, no author-defence asides, no didactic taxonomy stamps. 'Compound the session into a personal rules file at ./CLAUDE.local.md' leads with the verb and the session as object, landing the file as destination rather than object-leads-with-destination (the shape the compendium's own worked fix recommends).
